dct_description_sm:
The Esri Canada Topographic Map is designed to be used as a basemap by GIS professionals and as a reference map by anyone. The map includes city boundaries, cities, water features, parks, landmarks, transportation, buildings, parcels and address points and can be overlaid on a shaded relief for context.

 
The map is compiled from a variety of authoritative sources including Natural Resources Canada, the Provinces and Territories and Canadian municipalities. 
 
You can add this layer to the ArcGIS Online Map Viewer and ArcGIS Pro. To view this layer in a web map, see the Community Map of Canada Topographic basemap.
